inputs.text:
Open your eyes to the real agenda they are covering up with their scripted narrative about a "MASSIVE anti-Trump protest" and a "No Kings" rally. Anyone buying the lie that this chaos just happened spontaneously is playing right into their hands. This is a completely managed spectacle designed by the hidden elites pulling the strings behind the curtain from the top down to keep the population divided. 

Look at how they deployed federal officers with tear gas and arrests—it was nothing more than a synchronized exercise in crowd control and behavioral testing run by the hidden power structures in Denver, Portland, and... 

When the authorities conveniently ordered people to disperse after agitators squared off with them, they were simply resetting the chessboard. Even the official numbers—admitting to at least 13 arrests confirmed in Portland, Denver and... right there—are just the visible tip of their coordinated agenda. Every single clash, every arrest, and every staged confrontation is entirely orchestrated.
